title: Priority-smoother rebalance bug causing per-tenant token starvation and elevated 429s
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: A deployment of the new 'priority-smoother' feature to reduce per-route latency variance introduced a bug in the shard rebalance path that caused temporary double-withdrawal of tokens for a subset of tenant buckets. The double-withdrawal manifested as sustained 429 rates (up to 9% of requests) for affected tenants during peak windows on 2026-03-08. Impact: Multiple mid-market customers experienced degraded UX; on-call alerted at 02:12 UTC and mitigation rolled out by 03:05 UTC. Root cause: during shard handoff the smoother attempted to merge in-flight token deltas without deduplicating pending withdraw events, which in the rebalance window produced negative available-token accounting and immediate throttling. Contributing factors: insufficient end-to-end test coverage for concurrent rebalance+priority-smoothing, lack of a canary for rebalance-heavy regions, and an overly-aggressive default smoothing window.

This ticket tracks the post-incident follow-ups, fixes, and verification steps required to prevent recurrence.
timeline:
01:58 UTC - Auto-alert: global gateway 5xx/429s anomaly.
02:12 UTC - Pager duty: oncall (Marcus) acknowledged. Initial triage: 429 spike concentrated in us-west-2 and eu-west-1.
02:28 UTC - Rollback candidate identified: priority-smoother service. Temporary routing to stable workers selected.
02:45 UTC - Hotfix applied: disable smoother rebalance path via runtime flag; observed 429s drop within 7 minutes.
03:05 UTC - All traffic back to baseline.
05:10 UTC - Post-incident data collection complete; began root cause analysis.
action_items: ENG-94021-A1: Add deduplication guard in shard handoff to ensure token deltas are idempotent (owner: Marcus Chen, ETA: 2026-03-18)
ENG-94021-A2: Create integration test that simulates concurrent rebalance + request stream with smoothing enabled (owner: Priya Rao, ETA: 2026-03-16)
ENG-94021-A3: Add canary rollout policy that exercises rebalance codepaths in low-latency regions before global rollout (owner: Platform SRE, ETA: 2026-04-01)
ENG-94021-A4: Reduce default smoothing window from 120s to 30s while we validate stability, and expose as runtime flag (owner: Marcus Chen, ETA: 2026-03-14)
ENG-94021-A5: Instrument per-tenant token accounting with detailed audit logs for 72 hours after any rebalance (owner: Observability team, ETA: 2026-03-20)
ENG-94021-A6: Run load tests that mimic top-10 tenant traffic patterns to validate quota correctness post-fix before next release (owner: Performance QA, ETA: 2026-03-25)
ENG-94021-A7: Update runbook with specific rollback knobs for smoother and rebalance subcomponents and add playbook entries for SRE (owner: Oncall Lead, ETA: 2026-03-17)
ENG-94021-A8: Customer outreach: notify affected tenants with summary, RCA, and mitigation (owner: Customer Success, ETA: 2026-03-15)
ENG-94021-A9: Postmortem writeup and distribution to product and leadership (owner: Aisha Patel, ETA: 2026-03-14)
ENG-94021-A10: Schedule design review for smoothing algorithm to reason about safety properties (owner: Design/ML Infrastructure, ETA: 2026-04-05)
comments: 2026-03-09 Aisha Patel: Initial postmortem draft attached; team reviewed timeline and proposed action items. Linked the Confluence doc above.
2026-03-10 Marcus Chen: Implemented quick dedupe guard and tested locally; PR submitted (see PR link). Observability team added temporary audit logs for token operations.
2026-03-11 Priya Rao: Integration test framework extended to simulate shard handoff during high QPS; found an additional race when smoothing window overlaps handoff — added to test matrix.
2026-03-12 Observability: Grafana panels updated to show per-tenant withdraw/add delta; retention set to 14 days for the audit logs.
2026-03-13 Customer Success: Drafted notification for 4 affected customers; legal reviewed for compliance-sensitive wording.
